notes.title: Go Fight Fantastic Public Playtest!
notes.content:
We’re having a public playtest between 16/12 – 19/12! You will for the first time ever be able to collect meteorites and give them a go! You can either progress through a small piece from our Story Mode or slay enemies in the Horde Mode!  

[i]Choose between our four different characters and upgrade them with the meteorites!  [/i]

[b]Important note: online multiplayer isn’t enabled in this public playtest but will be when the game is released. [/b]

If you are feeling cocky and want to join some challenges – Join our Discord for the chance of winning the game and some other prizes!  

 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171948/63f842b5836fac4aeb0a8fcac9cc4057475502fa.png[/img]
 

And of course – don’t forget to add Go Fight Fantastic! On your wishlist!
